```{=typst}
#set text(font: font-body, size: 10.5pt)
#text(font: font-heading, size: 22pt, weight: "bold", fill: brand-primary, title)
#v(2pt)
#text(fill: brand-dim, period)
#v(10pt)
#summary
#v(10pt)
#table(
  columns: (1fr, auto),
  stroke: (x, y) => if y == 0 { (bottom: 0.8pt + brand-primary) } else { (bottom: 0.4pt + brand-border) },
  inset: (x: 4pt, y: 6pt),
  table.header([*Measure*], [*Value*]),
  ..figures.map(f => (f.label, f.value)).flatten(),
)
```
